decisions.reason: The enclosed laser workstation extends the firm's established laser offering and was only launched in 2023, so management sees its investment and its fit with the single-source portfolio as reasons to give it more time, despite its lower website visibility.

The high-resolution thermal inkjet printer has its own product page and sits close to the core coding business, so its public commitment and investment in in-house development make continuation very likely.

The piezo inkjet printer is prominently presented and central to the firm's message of matching technologies to each surface, so any early weakness would be put down to the ramp-up phase and the product kept.
